course_title: Haɓakar Noma da Inganta amfanin gona

say: Dabarun filin: giciye masu sarrafawa, iri mai kyau da gwaji na gaskiya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don tsari na 2 na Haɓakar Noma da Inganta amfanin gona.
Kiwo ana sarrafa pollination. Ka zabi uwa da uba, kuma ka toshe duk sauran pollen.

say: Mataki 1. Rufe harbin kunne da jakar harbi da zarar ya bayyana, kafin kowane siliki ya fito.

say: Mataki 2. Lokacin da siliki ya bayyana, yanke su kai tsaye da yamma, sa'annan a sake yin jaka a lokaci guda.

say: Mataki na 3. Da yammacin wannan rana, sai a rufe tassel ɗin uban da jakar tassel kuma a sa shi.

say: Mataki na 4. Da safe, bayan raɓar ta bushe, lanƙwasa tassel ɗin kuma danna jakar don haka pollen ya faɗi ciki.

say: Mataki na 5. Ɗaga jakar harbi da sauri, zuba pollen a kan siliki, kuma rufe kunne da jakar tassel.

say: Mataki na 6. Rubuta giciye a kan jaka da tag, uwa da farko, tare da kwanan wata.
Don tumatir, cire anthers daga toho kafin ya buɗe. Wannan ake kira emasculation.

say: A Najeriya, hukumar noma ta kasa, NASC, ta yi rajistar kamfanonin iri da kuma tabbatar da iri. Bincika lakabin don nau'in, lambar kuri'a, kwanan gwaji, mai samarwa da kowane magani.

panel.heading: Kyakkyawan lakabi da alamun gargaɗi
right: Sako da iri daga buhunan buhu
Babu lamba ko kwanan wata gwaji
Farashin mai nisa ƙasa da wasu
Jakunkuna da aka sake dinke, ɓawon hatsi

say: Yi hankali tare da sako-sako da iri, ɓatattun lambobi, farashi mai rahusa ko jakunkuna da aka sake dinke. A ajiye rasidin da jakar da babu kowa, sannan a kai rahoton iri na karya ga NASC.

say: An shafe iri da foda mai launi ko ruwa yawanci ana sanye da maganin kashe kwari. Kada ku ci shi, ko sayar da shi kamar hatsi, ko ciyar da shi ga dabbobi.

cards.d: Kar a taɓa yin dafawa, sayar da hatsi ko ciyarwa ga irin dabbobi masu launi mai launi.
Sanya safar hannu, kar a taɓa fuskarka, wanke hannu da sabulu bayan shuka.
Nisantar yara da dabbobi. Kada a sake amfani da buhunan iri mara komai don abinci.

say: Sanya safar hannu lokacin sarrafa shi, kada ku taɓa fuskar ku, kuma ku wanke hannuwanku da sabulu bayan shuka.
